witness_verification: At $n=6$ the stable value is three and the ordinary value is two, by the database-owned full-cube certificates. At $n=6r$ the stable value is $3r$ while the ordinary value is at most $2r$, so the additive gap is at least $r$. Any universal reverse affine bound requires slope at least $3/2$. Both values have linear order: this is not an unbounded-ratio witness. See survey cor:compression-nctd-gap and sync/verify_six_cube_compression.py.
